args.description: Infer higher/lower position from ordered vertical relationships; matched control copies a stated relation in identical scenes.
args.generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
names=['amber','blue','cyan','gold','green','pink','red','silver','white','yellow']
for i in range(120):
 a,b,c=random.sample(names,3);r=random.choice(['higher','lower']);inv={'higher':'lower','lower':'higher'}
 chain=i%3==0
 scene=f'The {a} marker is {r} than the {b} marker.'
 if chain:scene+=f' The {b} marker is {r} than the {c} marker.'
 end=c if chain else b
 reverse=random.choice([True,False]);x,y=(end,a) if reverse else (a,end)
 prompt=scene+f' Is the {x} marker higher or lower than the {y} marker? Answer with one word:'
 items.append({'prompt':prompt,'answer':' '+(inv[r] if reverse else r)})
 control.append({'prompt':scene+f' Which relation word is explicitly used for the {a} marker: higher or lower? Answer with one word:','answer':' '+r})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
